subject: german
summary: German reading-comprehension and short listening cards look good: one clear question, the right passage attached, and the scheme as a tidy list of tickable points with 'Any 2 of these - 3 marks each'. Several cards, however, ask something the card does not show: 'Fill in the grid below' with no grid, 'the phrases given in the box below' with no box or paragraph, 'the advertisement below' with no advertisement, and a letter task whose five topic areas are only on the attached page. The worst single fault is the 2014 OL job-application card, where the picture in the question area is a crop of the marking scheme (the model answer for point A) instead of the café advertisement. The Higher Level letter scheme is a long wall of grey text with broken line wraps and examiner abbreviations ('Op.', 'Cl.', 'Dis.'), and raw scheme slashes ('//', 'heat/ weather') and odd helper sentences ('The scheme heads this answer "Anruf von"') appear across the listening and comprehension cards. Every listening card shows 'The embedded recording could not be loaded' and none has an attached question page.

issues.title: Question-area picture is a crop of the marking scheme, not the advertisement
issues.detail: The question says 'You see the advertisement below in the local paper', but the image under the question is a crop of the SEC marking scheme: 'A. (2) Give your name, age and country of origin. Ich heiße .... Ich bin ... Jahre alt. Ich komme aus Irland. N.B. Look for THREE pieces of information for the full A2.', captioned 'German 2014 Ordinary Level marking scheme'. It sits in the question area above 'Your answer', so it gives away the model answer for point A, and the advertisement itself is never shown on the card. The crop is also tiny on the phone (text far smaller than body text). The attached pages open on option (a), the EssBar dialogue, which is a different task; (b) and its advert are further on.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the figure with a crop of the café advertisement from the question paper, and point the attachment at the page of option (b) only.

issues.title: Question refers to a grid, box or letter that the card does not show
issues.detail: Card 11 says 'Fill in the grid below, using the information from paragraphs 4, 5 and 6.' and shows no grid; the three names and the three headings (Working where?, Profession, Reason for/advantages of leaving Germany) are only visible after the reveal. Card 8 says 'complete the first paragraph of the letter by correctly inserting the phrases given in the box below' and shows neither the four phrases nor the paragraph; both are only on the attached page. Card 7 asks for answers to 'four of the five topic areas he/she has asked about' but Karl/Karla's letter is only on the attached page. In each case the typed question cannot be answered as shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the empty grid as a small table (people across, fields down). For the fill-in, print the four phrases as chips and the paragraph with numbered gaps. For the letter, show the letter text or a crop of it inline rather than behind the attachment button.

issues.title: Higher Level letter scheme is a wall of text
issues.detail: The scheme opens with about 45 lines of unbroken grey text on desktop (around two phone screens) that repeats the question, then runs the five topic areas A-E together with mark counts in brackets and broken line wraps: 'giving / detailed answers ... expressing your / personal opinion', 'Welche kostenlosen / Events gibt es'. After it come sections titled 'Op.', 'Cl.' and 'Dis.' (opening, closing, discretionary) with no explanation, and 'First point / Second point ...' mark pickers that carry no content, so the student must scroll back to the wall to find what earns each mark. On the phone the whole card is three full columns.
issues.suggested_fix: One collapsible block per topic area (A-E) with its sub-questions as a list and the mark for each, placed directly above that area's mark picker. Spell out Opening, Closing and Discretionary marks. Remove the copy of the question.

issues.title: Multiple-choice options and note template run into the question
issues.detail: Card 2 prints the options in the sentence: 'What solution does Theo propose in the case of persistent rain? (a) Take a survival course (b) Play computer games (c) Take the train (d) Have a party Indicate your choice by putting a, b, c, or d in the box provided.' Other MCQ cards (card 9) use tappable option boxes. Card 4's last bullet carries debris from the note template on the paper: 'the caller's phone number Schönberg Gesprächsnotiz erreichen. (Rufnummer) ____________'. Card 3 ends with the stray labels 'Stella: Jason:'. Card 9 keeps 'Tick (✓) the correct box. Tick one box only.' next to radio buttons.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the option-box component for card 2, remove the template debris on card 4 (or show the Gesprächsnotiz form as a proper box with its headings), and turn 'Stella:' / 'Jason:' into two labelled answer lines.

issues.title: Raw scheme slashes and awkward helper sentences
issues.detail: Answer rows keep the scheme's shorthand: 'how the heat/ weather affects people / makes them nervous / irritable / lethargic / lazy', 'decides that he can't let himself get affected by it // has to pull himself together', 'Ich kam von einer Baustelle// von der Arbeit. //Ich arbeitete die ganze Nacht.', 'black/leather armchairs (Plural needed) (chairs=0)'. The meaning of '/' versus '//' is never explained. Helper text reads oddly: 'The scheme heads this answer "Anruf von". (All or nothing)', 'The scheme heads this list "Jason".', 'The scheme prices the phrases on their own line', and card 11's 'each column is a row here, each of its cells a part at its printed mark, and a cell that prints a choice of its own is a list.' Card 3 ends a note with '(Allow: sie) (Allow: er)'.
issues.suggested_fix: Show alternatives as 'A or B' or as bracketed options with even spacing, and state once what '//' means or split those into separate rows. Replace the helper sentences with plain labels such as 'Caller's name' or 'Problem'.

issues.title: Confusing mark arithmetic
issues.detail: Card 11 shows '0m of 4m' beside each person, but each person's block is worth 10 (2 + 2 + 6) and the card is 30 marks. Card 4 is a 9-mark card whose rows add to 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 with the problem split across a single row and a separate 'One of these - 2 marks' box, so it is unclear how the problem marks are earned. Card 2 puts the rule about answering in German inside the answer row itself.
issues.suggested_fix: Show a per-person subtotal that matches the parts (out of 10) and group the note-taking scheme under the four headings of the note with the marks for each.

issues.title: Listening cards: audio not loading and no question page
issues.detail: All five listening cards show a dead 0:00 / 0:00 player with 'The embedded recording could not be loaded. Open the SEC recording.' (possibly a capture-environment fault). None has an attached question page. The introductions are long: on the phone card 4 has ten lines of instructions before the question.
issues.suggested_fix: Check the audio embed on a real device; shorten or collapse the listening instructions on the phone.

good_examples.why: One-line question, right passage attached, and eight short accepted points with 'Any 4 of these - 1 mark each'.
Short listening question with five clear one-mark points.
Question with line reference, passage with line numbers attached, compact tickable scheme.
